claims: Friday the 13th occurs when the 13th day of a month falls on a Friday.
The 13th guest at the Last Supper was Judas.
Jesus was crucified on a Friday.
Triskaidekaphobia is the fear of the number 13.
A study in the British Medical Journal (1990–1992) found no significant, consistent increase in traffic accidents on Friday the 13th compared to other Fridays.
In 2026, Friday the 13th occurs on February 13, March 13, and November 13.
The 1980 film Friday the 13th launched a slasher franchise.
The Friday the 13th franchise features the masked killer Jason Voorhees.
In Greece, Tuesday the 13th is feared.
